unit_system: natural-HEP: Q^2 in GeV^2; x, F_2, F_L and alpha_s are dimensionless
metric_signature: not-applicable (no amplitude is computed; Q^2 = -q^2 > 0 as in PDG Sec. 18.1)
coupling_normalization: alpha_s = g_s^2/(4 pi); coefficient functions expanded in a_s = alpha_s/(4 pi), C_L,a = sum_n a_s^n c_L,a^(n) [dispm:C04]
renormalization_scheme: MS-bar as stated by Moch, Vermaseren and Vogt; the O(alpha_s) F_L coefficient functions used here are scheme independent [dispm:C04]
scales: mu_R = mu_F = Q [dispm:C04]; alpha_s(Q^2) is an input per Q^2 point (toy values in the benchmark, not run)
energy_variable: Bjorken x = Q^2/(2 M nu) and Q^2 = -q^2 (PDG Sec. 18.1)
mass_approximation: massless quarks (n_f effectively massless flavours); target mass neglected (O(M^2/Q^2) dropped, PDG Eq. 18.21)
target_normalization: per nucleon: structure functions of one nucleon; the toy densities describe one invented nucleon
exchanged_bosons: photon only (F_2^gamma of PDG Eq. 18.18); no Z or W exchange
em_coupling: not-applicable (F_2 and F_L are defined without alpha; no cross section is computed)
structure_function_signs: not-applicable (no xF_3 term for photon exchange)
heavy_quark_scheme: zero-mass: all n_f flavours massless (toy n_f = 4); no heavy-quark mass effects
factorization_scheme: MS-bar [dispm:C04]; at O(alpha_s) the F_L result does not depend on it
dispm:observable: F_2(x, Q^2) at O(alpha_s^0) = x sum_q e_q^2 (q + qbar) [dispm:C01]; F_L(x, Q^2) at O(alpha_s^1) = F_2 - 2 x F_1, in the Altarelli-Martinelli form derived in derivations/derivation-record.md
dispm:parton_densities: number densities q(x), qbar(x), g(x) (not momentum densities x f); convolution C (x) f = int_x^1 dy/y C(y) f(x/y) [dispm:C02]; in this profile they are SYNTHETIC Beta-form toys
